name: NLnet Labs (Unbound, NSD)
description: Non-profit developer of DNS and routing software including Unbound, NSD, ldns and Routinator.
summary: NLnet Labs requires code and documentation contributions to be human-authored and does not accept LLM-generated content. LLM-assisted issue reports are allowed only with disclosure and human verification, LLM use in interactions must be disclosed and remains the human's responsibility, and pull request descriptions must use the contributor's own words.

evidence.quote: We require all code and documentation contributions to be authored by a human. You must not include content generated by LLMs or other probabilistic tools.
In your interactions with us, be respectful of our time, and disclose the use of an LLM. This includes opening issues, sending vulnerability reports, and posting on our community forum.
If an LLM assists you in finding or analysing an issue, you remain responsible to understand and verify the correctness of the information you share with us.

However, you remain responsible for the output of an LLM.
